text: Dr. Pichet examines teeth thoroughly; he's skilled and gentle. The other dentists are also very skilled.

restaurant_name: โฮม เด็นตัล คลินิก
text: The dentist did an excellent job with meticulous attention to detail. My ceramic filling is still in good condition after 10 years. The dentist is very patient. I've tried other places, but I always come back here because some places do a sloppy job and need the dentist to fix it.

restaurant_name: โฮม เด็นตัล คลินิก
text: The older female doctors aren't very friendly, and the prices aren't very friendly either.

restaurant_name: โฮม เด็นตัล คลินิก
text: The dentist and staff here are very kind. I had a long dental check-up, and they didn't charge me a single penny. Thank you so much!

restaurant_name: โฮม เด็นตัล คลินิก
text: Excellent. The doctor was very calm.
